entities.name: Jody Carpenter
entities.description: A middle-aged widower human from an unknown plane who ended up on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: Woman Jody had a one-night stand with.

entities.name: Saddlebrush
entities.description: Town with a main square where Jody met Annie again.

events.summary: After his wife's death, Jody travels from his home plane to Thunder Junction.
events.quote: Jody traveled from his home plane to Thunder Junction

events.summary: Jody meets Annie Flash and they have a one-night stand.
Jody meets Annie again in Saddlebrush's main square and denies leaving a mysterious basket on her doorstep.
events.quote: Jody denied leaving a mysterious basket on her doorstep

events.summary: Jody shows up to see Annie and the others off on the rattlewurm hunt.
events.quote: Jody showed up the next day to see Annie and the others off
